Scope and provenance

This report documents the completed, chip-specific discovery analysis for Y40105J2. It used frozen Reference18 continuous weights for Bin50 with UMI >= 50, the official 50 um radius neighborhood definition, native VoltRon CLR features, and independent K-means fits for K=3–12. The center Bin was excluded from its own neighborhood, matching the audited L3 framework.

  • UMI-eligible Bin50: 58,840
  • Neighborhood-evaluable Bin50: 58,772
  • Patients: 7 (HC=2;IPF=2;SSc-ILD=3)
  • Reference18 states: 18
  • Radius: 50 um
  • Random seeds per K: 20

Frozen lymphoid aggregate labels were not read. Disease labels were retained only as metadata and were not used for neighborhood construction, clustering, K selection, or niche annotation. This analysis did not perform disease-significance testing, DEG, GSEA, pathway analysis, or cell-cell communication analysis.

Audited J2 resolution recommendation and comparators
k role converged_seed_n seed_fit_n repeat_ari_median repeat_nmi_median betweenss_fraction min_niche_fraction min_patient_coverage_n below_one_percent_niche_n single_patient_niche_n within_patient_umi_eta_squared audited_reason
5 primary 20 20 0.988 0.979 0.237 0.157 7 0 0 0.040 K=5 retains 20/20 convergence, median ARI 0.988 and median NMI 0.979, all niches cover all seven patients, the smallest niche is 15.7%, within-patient UMI eta-squared is 0.040, and Reference18 composition separates broad B-enriched, endothelial-associated, alveolar-associated, airway-associated and stromal-associated gradients more clearly than K=3
3 lower-resolution comparator 20 20 0.997 0.993 0.174 0.282 7 0 0 0.018 K=3 is the automated-score optimum and highly stable (20/20 converged; median ARI 0.997), but combines several broad composition gradients and is therefore retained as an under-resolution comparator
7 higher-resolution sensitivity 19 20 0.797 0.795 0.280 0.093 7 0 0 0.042 K=7 is the nearest eligible higher-resolution sensitivity with 19/20 convergence, all-patient coverage, no niche below 1%, minimum niche fraction 9.3%, and lower UMI association than K>=8; its median ARI 0.797 requires sensitivity-only interpretation

K=5 is the audited primary resolution. It converged in 20/20 fits, had median pairwise ARI 0.988, covered all seven patients in every niche, and had a smallest niche fraction of 15.7%. K=3 is retained as an under-resolution comparator; K=7 is retained only as a higher-resolution sensitivity analysis. Disease separation was not a K-selection criterion.

The five niches represent mixed neighborhood-composition gradients rather than pure cell types. The most reproducible axes include AT1 enrichment in N1, B enrichment in N2, lymphatic-endothelial enrichment in N4, and blood-endothelial enrichment in N5. N3 has a broader mixed airway/stromal/immune profile. No core state was classified as single-patient-driven.

any_state_single_patient_driven and core_state_single_patient_driven are reported separately so that a weak peripheral state cannot invalidate a stable core composition axis.

UMI sensitivity

The core directions were retained after adjustment for scaled log1p(Bin UMI) and within-patient UMI-quantile stratification. These checks assess sensitivity; they do not establish that UMI effects have been completely removed.

Interpretation boundaries

J2 independently recapitulated broad B-enriched, alveolar-associated, endothelial-associated, airway-associated, and stromal/immune mixed themes. This is a blind descriptive comparison with L3, not a formal cross-chip alignment. Niche numbers are chip-specific and cannot be mapped across chips by number.

The analysis supports proceeding to a separate J2 spatial architecture audit and then an independently fitted Y40102K8 analysis. Cross-chip consensus and biological pathway analyses remain outside this report.
